scripts.lint: biome check src tests scripts package.json
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write src tests scripts package.json
scripts.test:coverage:all: bun run test:coverage && genhtml coverage/lcov.info --output-directory coverage/html && open coverage/html/index.html
scripts.test:coverage:html: bun run test:coverage && genhtml coverage/lcov.info --output-directory coverage/html
scripts.test:coverage:unit:ci: bun run test:coverage:unit:html && bun run coverage:check
scripts.test:coverage:unit:html: bun run test:coverage:unit && genhtml coverage/lcov.info --output-directory coverage/html
